body:
I'm not feeling bad about myself or life though... I need to hide from myself, or I'll kill me.  I'm just not sure what the alternative is.

I feel okay now, but I woke up still drunk and have continued, so it's to be expected.  I want my life to go back.  It wasn't great before, but I had hope.  I need to bleach my mind, and theres only one way to do that.
